steps.prompt: Write the square numbers $1, 4, 9, 16, 25, \ldots$ and the gaps between them. What do you see?

cards.title: The odd-number gaps
cards.body: The gaps between square numbers are $3, 5, 7, 9, \ldots$: the odd numbers. With the pattern, $(n + 1)^2 - n^2 = (n + 1 + n)(1) = 2n + 1$, the two numbers added.

steps.text: The numbers are next to each other: add them.

cards.title: Two apart
cards.body: For numbers two apart, $(n + 2)^2 - n^2 = (2n + 2) \times 2$: double their sum. $52^2 - 50^2 = 102 \times 2 = 204$.

prompts: Why must the gaps between squares be odd numbers?
